difficulty_reason: The dependent encode-decode construction identifies all based path spaces, with nontrivial transport and induction coherence; this is H2 rather than just the short fundamental-group corollary.

compared.difference: The prior flattening task concerns an arbitrary coequalizer total space; this specific circle identification is proved here by encode-decode. Alternative proofs of the same circle result and its homotopy-group corollaries are not counted.
Hypercubical manifolds concerns a different cubical presentation, not this book claim.
A Whitehead result for test categories has different objects and hypotheses; not this finitely truncated type theorem.
